# Vendored upstream code

`oiwer_core.py` is copied verbatim from AI4Bharat's official reference
implementation, MIT licensed (see `LICENSE_AI4BHARAT`).

Source: https://github.com/AI4Bharat/OIWER-Orthographically-Informed-Benchmarking-for-ASR
Commit: see `UPSTREAM_COMMIT`

It is vendored so our OI-WER numbers can be cross-checked against the authors'
own scorer rather than only against our reimplementation in `../oiwer.py`.
